summary: Hashed 2.5 accounts (for example bob-hash) keep their link, but other IdPs now map to the primary account by email; delete user-<hash> accounts to merge. RADIUS and TACACS+ give no email, duplicate emails make login fail, and LDAP usernames are lowercased.
questions: How do I merge hashed user accounts from AAP 2.5?
Login fails because multiple users have the same email
Are LDAP usernames case sensitive in AAP?
RADIUS users get new accounts on every authenticator
